title: Certified Personal Trainer
tagline: Advanced Personal Training • Female Fitness • Special Population • CPR & AED Certified
about: Hi, I'm Sai Karthik. I'm a certified personal trainer trained in advanced personal training, female fitness coaching and special population training. I'm also trained in CPR and AED, so your safety always comes first. Every plan is built around you: your goals, your body, your pace.

services.d: One-to-one programs for strength, fat loss and muscle gain with proper technique.
Training designed around women's goals, physiology and comfort.
Safe, guided training for seniors, beginners and people with special needs.
CPR and AED certified, so you train with a coach who is ready for emergencies.
